top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard. A caregiver utilized inappropriate language when referring to a child.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, it was determined that a caregiver allowed an infant to fall asleep in a restrictive device (swing) for approximately twelve minutes before removing the infant from the device and placing the infant in a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three children's files were missing healthcare professional statements.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 10 children were missing special care needs information in their admission paperwork.

top_violation_types.title: Gas Leak Inspection - Natural Gas (26 TAC §746.5403(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current gas inspection, the last one was conducted on April 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver used inappropriate discipline toward a child in care.
